summary: T1 Energy Inc. filed an 8-K after entering a Note Purchase Agreement on September 28, 2026 with a qualified institutional buyer that is already a shareholder, for a private placement of an additional $50.0 million principal amount of its 4.75% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031. Gross proceeds are expected at approximately $50.4 million, including accrued interest from July 31, 2026, with closing targeted September 30, 2026. Proceeds fund Phase 1 of the G2_Austin solar cell fab and general corporate purposes, characterized as a bridge toward a larger debt financing. Resale registration is required within 30 days; risk-arb focus is dilution and conversion overhang.
